title: Rainbow with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE066' stop-opacity='0.3'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFE066' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- Rainbow arcs -->
  <path d='M10 75 A40 40 0 0 1 90 75' fill='none' stroke='#FF4B4B' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M17 75 A33 33 0 0 1 83 75' fill='none' stroke='#FF9F1C' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M24 75 A26 26 0 0 1 76 75' fill='none' stroke='#FFE066' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M31 75 A19 19 0 0 1 69 75' fill='none' stroke='#4CD964' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M38 75 A12 12 0 0 1 62 75' fill='none' stroke='#5AC8FA' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M45 75 A5 5 0 0 1 55 75' fill='none' stroke='#AF7AE8' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Cloud puffs at ends -->
  <circle cx='12' cy='74' r='9' fill='#E8F4FF'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='77' r='7' fill='#D0E8FF'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='74' r='9' fill='#E8F4FF'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='77' r='7' fill='#D0E8FF'/>

  <!-- Smiling face on the rainbow -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='62' r='3.5' fill='#1A1A2E'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='62' r='3.5' fill='#1A1A2E'/>
  <!-- Eye highlights -->
  <circle cx='41.2' cy='60.8' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='61.2' cy='60.8' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M38 68 Q50 78 62 68' fill='none' stroke='#1A1A2E' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='69' r='3' fill='#FF8FA3' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='69' r='3' fill='#FF8FA3' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='50' r='1.5' fill='#FFE066'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='50' r='1.5' fill='#FFE066'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='1.5' fill='#FFE066'/>
</svg>
